title: OrganizationalUnit
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19e.5, PACK-08 implementation round. A lighter-weight node for subordinate structures not themselves a full Organization in the legal/statutory sense. Owned by organization-service (epd2_organization_service.domain.OrganizationalUnit); shares Organization's status/lifecycle machinery (draft/active/restricted/archived), never a parallel hierarchy.
